headline: A 5.9-magnitude earthquake struck Balochistan's Khuzdar district on Saturday morning at a depth of 25km, with no loss of life or property reported.

card.desc: No loss of life or property damage reported

caption:
A 5.9-magnitude earthquake jolted Balochistan's Khuzdar district on Saturday morning, Dawn and The Express Tribune reported, citing the Pakistan Meteorological Department. The quake struck at a depth of 25km, 48km northwest of Khuzdar, and no loss of life or property was reported.
